title: Topics
description: Open work items that ask for the same thing, grouped so a reader sees each request once. Only groups of two or more are listed; every other item stands alone. Every id must be a task, open question or objection in the same BIP folder, on the same piece, and in at most one topic. bips/<NNNN>/topics.yaml.

title.description: One plain sentence naming the shared request, written by whoever grouped it; not a quote.
